title: Member Equities & Patronage — Loan Closing Disclosure Schedule of Stock Requirement and Purchase Terms
content:
These are the purchase terms of each Member Equities & Patronage class: whether holding the class is a condition of borrowing, how much must be held, in what amounts it is bought and paid for, how far a balance may go, and how quickly a cancelled subscription is refunded.

## Terms by class

| | Class C Participation Certificate | Class A Nonvoting Common Stock | Class B Voting Stock | Qualified Allocated Surplus | Nonqualified Allocated Surplus | Class H Preferred Stock |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Holding the class is a condition of borrowing | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | No | No |
| Required holding, % of the combined original principal or commitment of the member's open loans (0 = no requirement) | 2 | 2 | 2 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Required holding never exceeds (USD; 0 = no requirement) | 1000 | 1000 | 1000 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Purchases are made in multiples of, rounded up (USD; 0 = not purchased) | 5 | 5 | 5 | 0 | 0 | 100 |
| Smallest single purchase (USD; 0 = not purchased) | 5 | 5 | 5 | 0 | 0 | 1000 |
| Largest balance a member may hold (USD; 0 = no limit) | 1000 | 1000 | 1000 | 0 | 0 | 1000000 |
| How a purchase may be paid | Cash at closing, or deducted from proceeds | Cash at closing, or deducted from proceeds | Cash at closing, or deducted from proceeds | Not purchased | Not purchased | Check or direct deposit |
| How required purchases are rounded | Up to a whole certificate | Up to a whole share | Up to a whole share | To the cent | To the cent | Up to the purchase increment |
| Calendar days after a subscription is cancelled within which a paid purchase is refunded (0 = not applicable) | 10 | 10 | 10 | 0 | 0 | 10 |

## Notes on the schedule

- The three borrower equity classes carry the same requirement terms: 2 percent of the combined loan amount, never more than USD 1000, bought in USD 5 multiples.
- Allocated surplus is never bought; it arises only from patronage allocations, so it has no requirement, no purchase increment, no minimum purchase and no limit on the balance.
- Class H Preferred Stock is bought in multiples of USD 100, the smallest single purchase is USD 1000, and the largest balance a member may hold is USD 1000000.

## Hypothetical rounding illustration

A requirement figure of USD 433.20 on a borrower equity class is rounded up to the next whole USD 5 multiple, USD 435.00. A figure that is already a whole multiple, such as USD 440.00, stays as it is.
